Can I put my own data into the generated infographics?

Yes. While the AI generates the initial layout and dummy text, Lovart's 'Edit Text' feature allows you to replace the placeholders with your actual statistics, headlines, and data points effortlessly.
What styles work best for LinkedIn B2B posts?
We recommend 'Flat Vector', 'Isometric 3D', or 'Minimalist Corporate' styles. Nano Banana excels at these clean, professional aesthetics that convey authority without being distracting.
How do I ensure the infographic matches my brand colors?
You can describe your color palette in the prompt (e.g., 'Use Navy Blue #000080 and Gold'), or upload a brand asset as a style reference for the Agent to mimic.
Is the text generated by AI legible?
Nano Banana is significantly better at text rendering than older models. However, if any text isn't perfect, you can simply click it and type the correct words using our built-in editing tools.
Can I export these for presentations too?
Absolutely. The high-resolution and SVG export options make these graphics perfect for PowerPoint decks, whitepapers, and website content, not just social media.
